title: Distributed Circumferential Coverage Control in Non-Convex Annulus Environments
summary: It has long been a prominent challenge in multi-agent systems to achieve distributed coverage of non-convex annulus environments while ensuring workload equalization among agents. To address this challenge, a distributed circumferential coverage control formulation is developed in this note by constructing a Riemannian metric for the navigation in the non-convex subregion while avoiding collisions with the region boundary.
